title: Respiratory visits (daily, by district)
summary: Daily counts of respiratory clinic visits per district of residence, held in the Valdena Health Office Azure warehouse (approx. 40,000 rows per catalog). Columns are visit_date, district and visit_count, with no patient identifiers per the catalog. Coverage is documented from 2022-01-01 with no end date, refreshed daily (last refreshed 2026-10-14), so it spans the production window 2024-2025 for need N4 (daily counts by district). Use is permitted for this surveillance analysis by the clinic data policy, which allows only these aggregated counts and not patient-level records.

schema.notes: Catalog lists three columns only. Respiratory diagnosis definition, district code scheme and small-cell suppression rule are not documented.

spatial.code_system: free-text district name or code (scheme not documented)
spatial.notes: Local Valdena districts by district of residence. Scheme and any boundary changes not documented in catalog or wiki.

documentation_excerpts: Respiratory clinic visits counted per day and per district. Contains no patient identifiers. (catalog clinic.resp_visits_daily)
Only daily counts by district (`clinic.resp_visits_daily`) may be used for this purpose. (wiki clinic_data_policy, last edited 2025-02-01)
Patient postcode and age band are personal data. They must not leave the clinic systems for analysis. (wiki clinic_data_policy)
quality_notes: Owner conflict: catalog says owner Clinical Analytics; wiki clinic_data_policy (2025-02-01) is owned by Data Protection Office. Both recorded; the policy governs permitted use.
Respiratory diagnosis definition (codes) is not documented in the catalog entry.
Small-cell suppression rule is not documented; small district-day counts may be unsuppressed.
District scheme and boundary changes are not documented.
Values are visit counts, not unique patients; whether a patient with several visits on one day is counted more than once is not documented.
Row count of about 40,000 (approximate) from 2022 is consistent with daily x district but the number of districts is not stated.

Catalog lists last_refreshed 2026-10-14 and exported 2026-10-14; the production window ends 2025-12-31, so coverage of 2024-2025 is complete per catalog start date, but completeness of individual days is not verified.
